critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2146 lines — >700-line limit exceeded. Recommend splitting into routers: /routers/tasks.py, /routers/service_reports.py, /routers/monthly_report.py, /routers/email.py, /routers/reports.py, /routers/cron.py.
monthly_report(): when first_sr.date > target month, historical_pest returns []. Consider always including target month row (even if zero) so the UI chart is not empty for early-month queries.

cron/auto-monthly-send: swallows individual customer failures inside asyncio.create_task job; consider persisting a job-run summary (success/failed counts) into an audit log for observability. Also asyncio.create_task inside a request lambda risks losing the coroutine reference on process shutdown — a proper background task queue (APScheduler already available since crons.yml exists, or arq) would be more reliable.
email-settings PUT: 'smtp_password: null' will pass the whitelist (not equal to '') and write null. Consider treating None the same as empty-string skip.
email-settings/test always returns 200 even on failure ({ok: false, error}). Consider returning 502 on hard failure so monitors can distinguish success from silent failure.

monthly_report_pdf pypdf import is wrapped in try/except ImportError — graceful degradation is good, but pypdf is in requirements.txt so this fallback would silently hide the SR merger being disabled. Log a warning at least.
